name: Kivi House
offer: A single-storey family home on a pine plot near Tallinn, with south glazing along the whole living room.
audience: Families looking for a calm, light-filled home within 25 minutes of Tallinn.
description: Kivi House: a 112 m² single-storey home with full-height south glazing. Take the tour, see the plan, book a visit.

sections.heading: Light from the south, all *day*.
body: A single-storey home drawn around one long window. Scroll to walk in.

sections.heading: Walk in.
body: From the road to the living room in one take.

seq.alt: A camera flies from the road over Kivi House, the roof lifts away to show the plan, and it lands in the living room facing the south glazing

items.label: 01 · Arrive
items.title: A low house among pines
items.body: One storey, one roof line, the entrance on the quiet east side.

items.label: 02 · The plan
items.title: Everything on one level
items.body: Living, dining and kitchen in one 52 m² room; two bedrooms and a bath behind it.

items.label: 03 · Inside
items.title: A 5-metre window
items.body: Full-height glazing faces south, so winter sun reaches the back of the room.

sections.heading: Book a visit
body: Leave your email and we will send times for a site visit.
